terms.comment: Traupman’s ploxenum (216, 329) is the hood of a car, not a garment; classically ploxemum or ploxenum is a Gallic word for a wagon-box (Catull. 97.6, quoted by Quintilian).

phrases.english: Put your hood up; it’s raining.

sources: Lewis & Short: cucullus · Lewis & Short: ploxemum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 216, 329.
